text: Kyoto ( or; Japanese: 京都, Kyōto [k̟ʲjó̞ò̞.tò̞] ), officially Kyoto City (京都市, Kyōto-shi; [k̟ʲjò̞ó̞.tó̞.ɕì, k̟ʲjó̞ó̞-], locally [k̟ʲjó̞ó̞.tó̞.ɕì]), is the capital city of Kyoto Prefecture in the Kansai region of Japan's largest and most populous island of Honshu. As of 2020, the city had a population of 1.46 million, making it the ninth-most populous city in Japan. More than half (56.8%) of Kyoto Prefecture's population resides in the city.

depictions.name: Kyoto
depictions.text: Kyoto (京都), originally called (平安京), is a major city in Japan, serving as the capital of Kyoto Prefecture in the Kansai region. The city is known for having served as Japan's imperial capital for centuries since the Heian period. It was originally modelled after the Tang capital of Chang'an in China, and served as the seat of power for the Ashikaga shogunate from 1333 until 1573.
